message: The module-surfaces registry (.engine/provisioning/module-surfaces.json) is a derived-committed artifact: it maps every file an engine module provides to its owning module id, generated from all module manifests in the source repo and shipped unchanged to deployments (so a declined module's surfaces stay recognisable). This check regenerates it from the present manifests and compares; if the committed registry was hand-edited or left stale after a provides change, it goes red. It is HOME-ONLY: a deployment carries only a subset of manifests, so a fresh derive there legitimately differs — the check is silent anywhere that is not a positively confirmed home repository. To fix it at home, regenerate with `uv run --directory .engine -- python tools/module_surfaces.py generate` and commit the result.
